card.name: Postmarketing experience and reports wording
card.fires_on: The word right after "postmarketing" or "post-marketing" (experience, reports, use), or the end of the word itself, in adverse-reaction sections. It also fires on spontaneous reports and on "have been" before reported.

modes.label: Inside or after postmarketing
modes.description: The ending of postmarketing, or the noun that follows it, such as experience, reports or use.
modes.example: In postmarketing<< experience>>, anaphylaxis has been reported

modes.label: Spontaneous reporting phrases
modes.description: Words in phrases about events being reported or described after approval, such as spontaneous reports or have been reported.
modes.example: Because these are spontaneous<< reports>>, estimates of frequency cannot be made and

card.writes: It pushes toward words about feedback, observations and collected reports.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says an event was seen or reported after the drug was on the market.
